name: Cold-Chain & Fishery Logistics Hub
description: Temperature-controlled warehousing, blast freezing, and cold-chain staging serving regional agri-fishery harvests and Poro Point shipping.
regulatoryNote: Prequalified for BOI and LGU Green-Lane fast tracking.

name: Eco-Boutique Coastal Resort & Wellness Hub
description: Sustainable coastal hospitality, villas, beachfront dining, and surf wellness retreat catering to North Luzon leisure travel.
regulatoryNote: Complies with CLUP Coastal Tourism Zone & 25m environmental setback.

name: Drive-Thru QSR & Commercial Retail Strip
description: Arterial commercial pad featuring dual-lane drive-thru QSR, specialty convenience retail, EV charging, and quick dining.
regulatoryNote: Requires standard Traffic Impact Assessment (TIA) by City Engineering.

name: IT-BPO Office & Tech Innovation Hub
description: Tier-2 BPO contact center facility, hybrid tech suites, shared fiber datacenter, and modern incubation space.
regulatoryNote: Eligible for PEZA IT Center registration & local business tax incentives.

name: Specialized Outpatient & Diagnostic Center
description: Multi-specialty diagnostic laboratory, ambulatory surgery, hemodialysis clinic, and medical suites serving Region I.
regulatoryNote: Requires DOH Licensing & PhilHealth accreditation clearance.

name: Artisanal Dining & Coastal Lifestyle Strip
description: Open-air food park, artisanal coffee roasteries, craft brewery taproom, and curated local surf-lifestyle boutiques.
regulatoryNote: Streamlined city business registration via LEBDO one-stop desk.

name: Light Industrial Assembly & Logistics Depot
description: High-bay logistics distribution depot, e-commerce last-mile sorting, and light manufacturing/assembly facility.
regulatoryNote: Full compliance with CLUP Industrial Zoning ordinance & zoning cert.
